name: RiffStorm
summary:
Grab the guitar. Unleash the storm.

RiffStorm is a rhythm-guitar game built for Meta Quest. Take the guitar off its stand with your own hand, rest the
other over the strings and play: the five controls on your fret-hand controller (X, Y, thumbstick, trigger and grip)
are the five strings, and your other hand really strums by moving up and down across them. Notes fly along the
highway toward the strum zone; press the right lanes and strum in time to chain combos.
